tagline: Fifty years later, humanity is still questioning what makes a soul.
description: Set in Los Angeles fifty years after Blade Runner 2049, a renegade blade runner uncovers a bio-synthetic syndicate that threatens what remains of human society.

title: Arcane: Final Chapter & Aftermath
tagline: Every monster was once a child.
description: The concluding chapter in the Piltover and Zaun war, featuring unreleased soundtrack orchestration and high-fidelity animation sequences.

title: Project Hail Mary
tagline: One lone astronaut. One alien ally. The salvation of Earth.
description: An astronaut survives as the sole crew member on a desperate deep space mission to find a cure for a cosmic infection extinguishing the sun.

title: Cyberpunk: Phantom Echoes
tagline: Night City forgets nobody, and forgives nothing.
description: A new crew of netrunners and solo mercs investigate a forbidden Arasaka consciousness transmission beneath the Pacifica ruins.

title: Interstellar: Beyond the Event Horizon
tagline: Mankind was born on Earth. It was never meant to die here.
description: The 12th anniversary theatrical reissue in uncompressed 70mm IMAX and Dolby Vision with Hans Zimmer live studio soundtrack sessions.

title: Avatar: Fire and Ash
tagline: Discover the Ash People of Pandora.
description: Jake Sully and Neytiri encounter a new, aggressive volcanic clan known as the Ash People as conflicts deepen across Pandora.

title: Stranger Things 5: The Final Season
tagline: One last adventure to save Hawkins and the world.
description: The Upside Down has broken through into Hawkins. The party unites for their ultimate and most perilous confrontation with Vecna.

title: The Batman Part II
tagline: The shadows have deepened.
description: Bruce Wayne continues his journey as Gotham City becomes more fractured, facing a cold and calculating threat that emerges from the flooded streets.

title: Spider-Man: Beyond the Spider-Verse
tagline: Can Miles Morales write his own story?
director: Joaquim Dos Santos, Kemp Powers, Justin K. Thompson
description: Miles Morales travels across dimensions to confront Earth-42 and unite the Spider-Society against the ultimate multiverse collapse.

title: The Last of Us: Season 2
tagline: When you're lost in the darkness, look for the light.
description: Five years after their dangerous journey through the post-pandemic United States, Ellie and Joel settle down in Jackson, Wyoming, before past sins resurface.

title: Severance: Season 2
tagline: Please try to enjoy each episode equally.
description: Mark and his colleagues learn the dire consequences of trifling with the severance barrier, leading to even greater mysteries on the severed floor.

title: Avengers: Doomsday
tagline: Victor von Doom has arrived.
description: The Avengers assemble across timelines to confront Doctor Victor von Doom as the fabric of the multiverse begins its ultimate incursion.

title: Blade Runner 2099
tagline: More human than human in 2099.
description: Set fifty years after Blade Runner 2049, a new generation of blade runners investigate a synthetic conspiracy that threatens to rewrite human existence.

title: Peaky Blinders: The Immortal Man
tagline: Tommy Shelby's final reckoning.
description: Set during World War II, Tommy Shelby is pulled back into the shadows to protect Birmingham and England from covert existential threats.
